registrar_rulings.reason: Not priced under any spelling: sour-cream is live at $0.1025/oz but crema is a different purchase (cultured pourable table cream, 15 oz Hispanic-dairy SKU, different fat/salt/price class), and the estate already agrees - the creme-fraiche commodity and one other row both carry '\bcrema\s+(?:mexicana|salvadorena|agria)\b' as an EXCLUDE, i.e. crema was twice deliberately kept out of neighboring dairy ids and never claimed. Deliberate variant, not duplicate. Mint in the recipe-only namespace (recipe-board baseline + recipe-commodities). Follow-ups: (1) allowlist pairs mexican-crema<->sour-cream and mexican-crema<->creme-fraiche with reason 'distinct cultured-cream SKUs, different form/price class'; (2) include patterns around 'crema\s+mexicana', 'mexican(\s+style)?\s+crema', 'crema\s+salvadorena' - do NOT include bare 'crema' (espresso crema, crema agria = sour cream) or 'table cream' alone (Nestle media crema is uncultured, a different product); build excludes to neighbor rigor (~150 patterns) covering coffee creamer, media crema, sour cream, dips.

Not priced under any spelling: the true nearest neighbor is monterey-jack-cheese (live, $0.2188/oz Aldi, 5 stores, all plain domestic Jack blocks per the board rows) - the common SUBSTITUTE for queso Chihuahua but a different cheese and SKU; the shredded-cheese bridge the mapper refused prices bagged cheddar/blend at $0.1521/oz, a different food, and its refusal matches the estate's parmesan/mozzarella precedents of 2026-08-26. No chihuahua/oaxaca/quesadilla/asadero string exists anywhere in the three namespaces or the feed. Deliberate variant, not duplicate. Mint in the recipe-only namespace. Follow-ups: (1) allowlist pairs chihuahua-cheese<->monterey-jack-cheese and chihuahua-cheese<->shredded-cheese with reason 'distinct specialty melting cheese vs domestic substitute/blend'; (2) include patterns 'chihuahua', 'queso\s+chihuahua', 'quesadilla\s+cheese', 'queso\s+menonita' - and because 'quesadilla' also names prepared foods, excludes MUST cover tortilla, frozen quesadillas, kits, seasoning, taquitos, dips, at neighbor rigor (~150 patterns); (3) capture caveat: this is a Hispanic-dairy specialty SKU (V&V Supremo class) - if the seven-store capture finds no genuine Chihuahua SKU, fall back to monterey-jack-cheese via a floor-map alias rather than letting the include claim a Jack or blend product.

macro_cross_check: Ours (4-serving source basis, all 9 lines now costed): 752 cal / 49.3 g protein / 48 g carbs per serving. Source published 519 cal / 41 P / 29 C. Protein +20% and calories +45% - OUTSIDE the 15% protein band, so I looked for the wrong portion rather than rounding. No single line is wrong: 12 tortillas at 25 g, 3 cups shredded cheese at 112 g/cup and 2.5 cups shredded chicken at 140 g/cup are all standard, and 3 tortillas plus 1/2 cup salsa alone already exceed the published 29 g carbs, so the source's panel is internally impossible at 4 servings. Our totals divided by SIX servings give 501 cal / 32 C, which matches the published panel closely - i.e. Isabel Eats' numbers are per 2 enchiladas while the card says 4 servings of 3. FLAG: on the card's own 4-serving basis this dish is about 752 cal and 48 g carbs per serving, which breaks BOTH this run's 650 cal ceiling and its 35 g carb cap. That is a screening call for the orchestrator, not a mapping defect; the grams above are what the recipe actually contains.
